Standard: The ECS supplies air at the pressure, flow, temperature, and humidity compatible with protective flight garment supply systems (e.g. pressure suits, anti-g garments, or ventilation garments). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to verify that the ECS meets protective flight garment interface requirements under all air vehicle operating conditions. Test.
  (1) Ground test: Conduct ground testing to verify that the ECS meets protective flight garment interface requirements under air vehicle ground operating conditions. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that the ECS meets protective flight garment interface requirements under all air vehicle flight operating conditions.
